# Leading Analytical Work: Review, Standards and Stakeholders

> Set the unit's quality standard, run review as a system, and hold the line on evidence with sponsors. SDAIA Academy course DS-407, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 16,095 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Set the standard](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/slides/day1.md): An assurance standard, a team checklist, re-runs as a rule and rules for assisted work; sessions: Assurance proportionate to risk, A team review checklist, Reproducibility as a team rule, Rules for AI-assisted analysis; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/slides/day1.html; about 4,996 tokens
- [Day 2: Review and develop](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/slides/day2.md): Calibrated reviewers, audits of assisted work, feedback and a review rota; sessions: Calibrating reviewers, Auditing assisted work, Feedback that builds skill, Review capacity and mentoring; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/slides/day2.html; about 4,515 tokens
- [Day 3: Work with sponsors](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/slides/day3.md): Scope, evidence agreed first, pressure on a finding, and quality reported honestly; sessions: Scope and deadline, Agreeing the evidence first, Pressure on a finding, Reporting quality and correcting errors; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/slides/day3.html; about 4,343 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: the staffing pack and the review meeting](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/slides/capstone.md): A quality-assurance pack for the marine pilot staffing analysis, and the review meeting you chair; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/slides/capstone.html; about 1,616 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Six requests, four levels](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/labs/D1_1_assurance_levels.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: A checklist adapted from REFORMS](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/labs/D1_2_team_checklist.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Re-run Saleh's repository](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/labs/D1_3_rerun_repository.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Rules for assisted work](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/labs/D1_4_ai_rules.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Two reviewers, one analysis](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/labs/D2_1_calibrate_reviewers.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Audit five assisted analyses](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/labs/D2_2_audit_assisted.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Feedback and a three-month plan](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/labs/D2_3_feedback_plan.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: A quarter's review rota](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/labs/D2_4_review_capacity.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: A result in a week](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/labs/D3_1_scope_deadline.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: An analysis agreement](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/labs/D3_2_analysis_agreement.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Drop the feeder result?](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/labs/D3_3_pressure_finding.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: A quality statement and a correction](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-407/labs/D3_4_quality_correction.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
